children: UK door and window maker's H1 revenue rose 6% yr/yr, driven by Alunet acquisition
Adjusted operating profit for H1 increased 10% yr/yr, supported by Alunet and cost control
Company implemented restructuring, including branch closures and headcount reduction, to improve profitability
Eurocell says Q2 sales momentum has continued into H2 and expects further progress in 2026
Company says demand in RMI market remains subdued and new build housing conditions are challenging
Eurocell has paused new branch openings until there is better economic visibility
ALUNET CONTRIBUTION - Alunet acquisition drove revenue and adjusted operating profit growth, with H1 sales up 13% yr/yr on a calendar basis due to market share gains
RESTRUCTURING ACTIONS - Co implemented branch closures, recycling plant consolidation and targeted headcount reduction to increase profitability
SUBDUED DEMAND - Weak trading conditions in RMI and new build housing weighed on organic sales, with Profiles division sales down 5% yr/yr
The current average analyst rating on the shares is "strong buy" and the breakdown of recommendations is 2 "strong buy" or "buy", no "hold" and no "sell" or "strong sell"
The average consensus recommendation for the construction supplies & fixtures peer group is "buy."
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for Eurocell PLC is GBp205.00, about 66% above its September 2 closing price of GBp123.50
The stock recently traded at 7 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 6 three months ago
